issue: Helm templates should be used to force consistency among charts [closed; labels kind/enhancement, lifecycle/stale, lifecycle/automatically-closed, area/charts]
**Describe the feature request**

Right now, there is no consistency between Istio Helm charts for how basic things like

- labels
- annotations
- image URLs

are templated.

This is because each chart does each of these things their own way.

The way to solve this is have a single template for all charts, such that given the same set of values, it will spit out exactly the same structure, for each chart, respecting the (local | …

https://github.com/istio/istio/pull/51517/files#diff-9e517c2405d381930226cbdc5b4ec16976f5c4939bc34bc145214a71df658be2R87

Example:

---
In every chart we do something like:

```
labels:
istio.io/component: ztunnel
operator.istio.io/component: Ztunnel
k8s-app: ztunnel
app: ztunnel
{{ with .Values.labels -}}{{ toYaml . | nindent 4}}{{ end }}
```

This would be replaced with a template, so each chart would have.

```
labels:
{{ template "istio-labels" . }}
```

instead.

We don't have to do this for everything, but …
